chart.title: Sweep of equal lows > no reclaim
chart.subtitle: Stops taken at 24,390. Delta still red...

caption:
A sweep isn't a REVERSAL. ⚠️

Equal lows at 24,390 get swept, the stops are taken and everyone goes long. But the candle closes BELOW the lows, the bounce can't reclaim them and delta stays at -1,900: sellers are still pressing. A sweep only tells you where to look. The footprint tells you if buyers actually showed up.

1️⃣ A sweep is a location, not an entry
2️⃣ Wait for a close back above the swept lows
3️⃣ No delta flip, no stacked buy imbalances = no trade
